system: Cosmic Astrological Minds (C.A.M.) Web & Admin Platform

squad_a_architecture.name: Squad A: Core Architecture & System Contracts

agents.focus: Overall system topology, API contract standards, schema alignment between React, Laravel, and MySQL.
Zodiac signs, planetary rulers, elemental triplicities, modalities, and celestial charts for the C.A.M. club.
RBAC policy definitions (SuperAdmin, Officer, Member, Guest), token lifecycles, and audit policies.
OpenAPI specifications, JSON:API response formats, pagination conventions, and TypeScript-to-PHP DTOs.

squad_b_design_system.name: Squad B: Celestial Design System & UX

agents.focus: Tokens for Blue, Gold, Indigo, Purple palette, typography, glassmorphism blur tokens, and contrast ratios.
Design specs for zodiac cards, star-chart visualizers, celestial buttons, badges, modals, and navbars.
Orbital animations, constellation SVG connections, shimmer effects, and starfield canvas backgrounds.
Roster management flows, astrological distribution graphs, meeting scheduler, and executive dashboards.
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility in dark celestial mode, keyboard navigation, screen-reader friendly astrological symbols.
Vite/React SPA setup, router configuration, Tailwind / CSS variables integration, and layout wrappers.
Club hero page, Cosmic Astrological Minds mission statement, event teaser, and join club form.
Interactive 12-sign zodiac wheel, birth sign explorer, and dynamic club horoscope preview.
Administrative layout, quick metrics (member count, sign distribution, upcoming sessions), alerts.
Searchable member table with sign filtering, CSV export/import triggers, and member edit modals.
Login / Register screens, JWT/Sanctum bearer token handling, protected route guards, and logout flow.
Axios client / TanStack Query hooks, query cache management, toast notifications, error handling.

squad_d_laravel_backend.name: Squad D: PHP Laravel Backend Engineering

agents.focus: Application structure, middleware stack, API routing `/api/v1`, CORS configuration, and exception handling.
Laravel Sanctum token authentication, login, registration, token refresh, and password security.
Laravel Gates, Policies, and middleware for role-based permissions (Admin, Officer, Member).
Member Eloquent model, CRUD controller, validation FormRequests, and ingestion engine for members.csv.
Zodiac sign logic, planetary calculation helpers, elemental affinities, and daily club insights.
Club stargazing sessions, workshops, guest lectures, RSVP tracking, and calendar feeds.
Logging administrative changes, member signups, role updates, and security events.

squad_e_database.name: Squad E: MySQL Database & Data Pipeline

agents.focus: Normalized relational schema: users, members, zodiac_signs, events, rsvps, audit_logs.
Declarative Laravel migrations, foreign keys, cascading deletes, and column constraints.
Initial data seeders for all 12 zodiac archetypes and initial seed load from members.csv.
Performance indexes on member email, sign_id, role, and event dates.
Automated mysqldump scripts, backup restoration test procedures, and data safety.

squad_f_devops.name: Squad F: Cloud DevOps & Infrastructure (DevOps Specialists)

agents.focus: Multi-container Docker Compose environment uniting React, Laravel PHP 8.5, MySQL 8.0, and Nginx.
Reverse proxy routing frontend SPA and `/api` backend requests, SSL/TLS termination, HTTP security headers.
GitHub Actions workflows for automated linting, test suites, container builds, and deployment verification.
Cloud-ready deployment recipes (AWS/GCP/DigitalOcean/Render/Railway), env secret management, and healthchecks.
